name: Bible
purpose: This capsule provides the Bible item definition and related feature wiring for Verbum.

name: Book Enhancement
purpose: Provide a library-backed book system that allows very large books (e.g., the full Bible) to be read from a vanilla written book without storing megabytes in item NBT.

name: Book Of Hours
purpose: Provide a cozy Vocations profile manual as a library-backed book item. The capsule introduces practical, player-facing orientation text for calm pastoral play without adding platform logic.

name: Dusty Devotional
purpose: This capsule provides a Veritas profile manual as a library-backed book item. It offers a short orientation to how baseline Verbum should feel: clear, durable, and grounded.

name: Pilgrims Atlas
purpose: This capsule provides a Visions profile manual as a library-backed book item. It gives players a concise field-guide orientation to the flagship line: broad, luminous, and feature-rich.

name: Rule Of Ashes
purpose: This capsule adds a Vorago profile manual item, `Rule of Ashes`, as a library-backed book. It frames Vorago as Visions under harsher laws: pressure, scarcity, risk, and discipline.
